title: HTTP: Improved robustness and memory freed
description:
- No longer pass curr into process_header(). Use curr_req_res instead.
  (no need to pass this in).
- struct curr is checked to see if it exists before use.
- The code to extract the first number of the range has been
  rewritten
- g_new was replaced with wmem_new
- "first_crange_num_str = wmem_alloc(scope, 100);" was removed.
- curr_req_res->resp_has_range = TRUE; was moved outside the if
  because regardless of a match or not, the HTTP packet has a Range;
  otherwise it would not be in "case HDR_CONTENT_RANGE".

notes.body:
Hi cal,

Can you look/fix

```
epan/edissectors/packet-http.c:2072:7: warning: Access to field 'transfer_encoding_chunked' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'headers') [core.NullDereference]
epan/dissectors/packet-http.c:3788:5: warning: Value stored to 'first_crange_num_str' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
epan/dissectors/packet-http.c:3791:5: warning: Value stored to 'first_crange_num_str' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
epan/dissectors/packet-http.c:3792:5: warning: Value stored to 'first_crange_num_str' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
epan/dissectors/packet-http.c:3848:8: warning: Value stored to 'top_of_list' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
epan/dissectors/packet-http.c:3855:33: warning: Access to field 'resp_has_range' results in a dereference of a null pointer (loaded from variable 'curr_req_res') [core.NullDereference]
```

Hi Alexis,
I've amended the commit with some checks for NULL. If the top_of_list
warning remains, I believe it's a false positive. Thanks.

for top_of_list, you need to replace ?


`top_of_list = g_slist_delete_link(top_of_list, top_of_list);`
by 

`g_slist_delete_link(top_of_list, top_of_list);`

There is also always this error too
https://www.wireshark.org/download/automated/analysis/scan-build-2024-04-13-100231-3130-1/report-a5a59a.html#EndPath
Thanks, Alexis. I just pushed an amended commit.

Hi Alexis,

The change caused a lot of pipeline errors like this:

"/builds/cturney111/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-http.c:3844:57: error:
ignoring return value of 'g_slist_delete_link' declared with attribute '
*warn_unused_result*' [-Werror*=unused-result*]
 3844 | g_slist_delete_link(top_of_list, top_of_list);

I won't make a new commit to change it back until I hear from you.
I got rid of the pipeline errors by simplifying that section. I tested it and it worked fine.

commits_data.title: HTTP: Improved robustness and memory freed
commits_data.message:
HTTP: Improved robustness and memory freed

- No longer pass curr into process_header(). Use curr_req_res instead.
  (no need to pass this in).
- struct curr is checked to see if it exists before use.
- The code to extract the first number of the range from HTTP requests
  and resplonses has been rewritten
- g_new was replaced with wmem_new
- "first_crange_num_str = wmem_alloc(scope, 100);" was removed.
- curr_req_res->resp_has_range = TRUE; was moved outside the if
  because regardless of a match or not, the HTTP packet has a Range;
  otherwise, it would not be in "case HDR_CONTENT_RANGE".
- Tests for NULL have been added to eliminate some warnings.
- Simplified the g_slist_delete_link() code and eliminated pipeline
  errors associated with it.
- Fixed "Access to field 'transfer_encoding_chunked' results in a
  dereference of a null pointer" error.
